review.coverage: n=1, m=1, n=m=5000, x=1, x=1e9, innermost-ring cases, all four n/m parities, many zero answers, non-square boards; max answer 9998.
review.incorrectAreAlgorithmic: Every incorrect source read in full; each prints a numerically wrong single answer on at least one valid test (not just formatting/debug output).
review.independentOracle: black cells (i+j even) with min(i,j,n-1-i,m-1-j)==x-1 via concentric-rectangle parity counts; cross-checked against literal simultaneous-repaint simulation for all n,m<=15, x<=9.
review.officialTests: official_tests_complete; every official pinned-row pair present in package (inputs equal after CRLF normalization, outputs token-equal); source row byte-equal to independently downloaded, hash-verified pinned open-r1/codeforces parquet row.
review.oracleResult: All 226 package tests and all samples pass strict format/range parse; every expected output equals my oracle; all official upstream rows also equal my oracle.
review.preservedContradictions: build-gaps/40B.json is a superseded diagnostic not consumed by publication_gate. Prior signoff was revoked in 6c46613 for ambiguous flattened bounds; this audit binds only the new normalized package 34593c7066bbd161d81fb2bc728597553b8f290b634983eea8f9274877af594c.
review.sandbox: Own harness (sha256 c582ff42...983d0d, not worker pool_harness): pinned python@sha256:5887f265...05d3, --network=none, --read-only, --user=65534, --cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, pids<=32, 1 CPU, 2560m memory, RLIMIT_CPU/AS at problem limits, bounded output, launched from env -i shell without credentials; re-run against the normalized-six archive bytes.
review.singleAnswer: Output is one integer uniquely determined by the input; token comparison is correct, no special checker, no float tolerance.
review.statement: Packaged input bound "1 ≤ x ≤ 10<sup>9</sup>"; original package HTML ("1 ≤ x ≤ 109") preserved byte-identical in statement-sources/40B.original.html; diff is exactly that one line. Attested public English source https://codeforces.me/contest/40/problem/B raw snapshot hash matches attestation and contains sup.upper-index markup; I re-fetched it and Luogu CF40B independently (both show 10^9). 43/70 official x exceed 109, max 1e9.
review.submissionProvenance: All 10 sources byte-identical (sha256) to rows in pinned open-r1/codeforces-submissions shards (shard sha256 verified independently); evidence sourceHash equals sha256 of those bytes.
